```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(glue)
library(purrr)

talks <-
  read_csv("data/talks.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    across(where(is.character), \(.x) replace_na(.x, "")),
    date = as.Date(date)
  )

upcoming <- 
    talks |> 
    filter(status == "upcoming") |> 
    arrange(date)

past <- 
    talks |> 
    filter(status == "past") |> 
    arrange(desc(date))

render_talk <- function(title, venue, location, date, status, description, video_url) {
  cat(glue("### {title}"), "\n")
  cat(glue("**{venue}** | {location}"), "\n\n")
  cat(description, "\n\n")
  if (nchar(video_url) > 0) {
    cat(glue(
      '<div style="position: relative; padding-bottom: 56.25%; height: 0; overflow: hidden; max-width: 100%; margin-top: 1rem;">',
      '<iframe style="position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; border-radius: 12px;" src="{video_url}" title="{title}" allowfullscreen></iframe>',
      '</div>'
    ), "\n\n")
  }
  cat("---\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: upcoming
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

if (nrow(upcoming) > 0) {
  cat("## Upcoming\n\n")
  upcoming |> 
    pwalk(render_talk)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: past
#| echo: false
#| results: asis


if (nrow(past) > 0) {
  cat("## Past\n\n")
  past |> 
    pwalk(render_talk)
}
```
